title: nomue verifier refusal
description: Machine-readable refusal emitted when a normal verification report cannot be produced (NRS-CORE-0011). A refusal carries no overall status, no VERIFIED value, no verification outcome, and no scientific-validity evaluation; it is never a partial success (NRS-SEC-0004). Fields that could not be read from the input are omitted, never fabricated: there is no record reference, because no Record was interpreted. Supersedes urn:nomue:schema:verifier-refusal:0.2.0-draft.2 by adding the processing_timeout and memory_limit limit_category values for the in-process time and memory bounds of NRS-SEC-0006 (ADR-0022); the draft.2 schema is retained unmodified as a historical artifact.

declared_bundle_id.$comment: Present only for unsupported_bundle refusals, where the declared identifier was readable. A routing_error refusal has no readable declared identifier by definition (missing or non-string), so the field never appears there.

limit_category.$comment: Present for resource_limit refusals (NRS-SEC-0005). processing_timeout and memory_limit are checked in-process at pipeline checkpoints (NRS-SEC-0006), not by an external test harness.
